baseline: P2 UD_IMST strength 1.0; P3 did not qualify for promotion
training: All 3260 IMST TRAIN sentences, identical verified P3 fresh P1-combined candidate cache. DEV/CALIB error examples never used for fitting. TEST not opened.

head.target: Conditional correct lexical view within each native analysis; old head scores are frozen offsets
head.selection: DEV-only: lexical lemma+POS and lexical declared features nondecrease; maximize lemma+POS then features then simpler strength. Native choices, scores and confidence remain exactly P2.

rank.target: Per-token partial-label likelihood with frozen P2 full-sentence max-marginal offsets; positives must match the view actually emitted by the fixed head, not any latent view
rank.training_population: Common competitive TRAIN words with a strict emitted-output positive for both heads; same rows and budget for both fits
rank.scope: One fit against fixed baseline max-marginals, followed by full fresh decoding. This is a local surrogate, not joint CRF maximum likelihood. Only final main UA residual changes; legacy Q0, UA reference passes, P2 head contribution, AB04 and n-gram weights remain fixed.

final_selection: DEV-only native lemma+POS and declared features nondecrease, wrong native committed lemma decisions nonincrease, lexical lemma+POS and declared features nondecrease against P2. Among safe configurations maximize lexical lemma+POS then lexical features then native lemma+POS then simpler contribution. Include control and selected head-only arm.
CALIB: Only P2 control and one DEV-sealed final configuration. No adjustment after CALIB. If protection fails keep P2; retain exploratory results.

A2.scope: Native lemma+POS and declared features. No lexical-view confidence or full morpheme-path calibration claim.

guards: Fixed ordered native candidates and lexical views
Head-only leaves native outputs and scores unchanged
No gold or selected-neighbour leakage into runtime features
Positive training labels follow emitted views
Lossless BPE roundtrip and identical 224309 IDs
Original P2/P3 sources, models and reports unchanged
